removed_uncertainties.text: Line 15: printed with a wide gap after מֵרֹאשׁ and the period after וָדוֹר. Transcribed as printed. Dagesh in דְרוֹשׁ is not visible.
Line 16: the separator after עָלֶֽיךָ is comma-shaped.
Line 18: whether it is כְּשִׁיר (sheva) or כַּשִּׁיר, and whether a yod is present in קָרְבָּנֶֽיךָ.
